full_judgment: 4. The learned Single Bench further held that the original suit was one under section 77 of the Registration Act for registration of the disputed document which was dismissed by the trial court on the ground that there was no material on record to indicate that any appeal was filed before against the order of the Sub-Registrar. The said decision was affirmed by the appellate court on the finding that in view of the admitted fact the appellate court directed that the disputed kabala Ext.1 to be registered in the office of the Sub-Registrar, Jhenidah if it is duly presented for registration within 30 days of the decree. The High Court Division also observed that this order was not stayed by the High Court Division and accordingly the High Court Division concluded that the kabala Ext.1 has been registered long back sometimes in later part of 1975 of in the early 1976 and accordingly rejected the application.
